brand_identity.name: God's Lifting International School
brand_identity.mission: Divine instruction, qualitative education, global standard.
brand_identity.archetype: Organic & Earthy (Trust/Growth) mixed with Swiss Authority
brand_identity.target_audience: Parents, Students, Teachers in Lagos, Nigeria

headings.usage: Main headers, section titles, hero text. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI labels, data tables. Use normal or slightly loose tracking.

accents.usage: Small handwritten notes, 'divine' quotes, or playful accents for pre-school sections.

primary.description: Royal Blue - Represents Trust, Authority, and Intelligence.

secondary.description: Golden Amber - Represents Excellence, Divinity, and Success.

accent.description: Sky Blue - Represents Growth, Clarity, and Peace.

dashboard.card_style: Flat white cards with subtle borders, no heavy shadows.
dashboard.sidebar: Fixed width (250px), dark blue or white with distinct active states.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border-2 border-primary/10 hover:border-primary/30 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.feature: bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-card hover:shadow-float transition-all duration-300 group
cards.stat: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 flex flex-col gap-2

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white

hero.description: Happy students in classroom - Hero Section Main

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Parallax effects on hero images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Use dark slate (#0F172A) on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' font for all headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text.
Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the features section on the homepage.
Use the provided image URLs for specific sections (Hero, About, Facilities).
Ensure the 'Apply Now' button is prominent and uses the primary Royal Blue color.
The Student Portal should be clean, distraction-free, and mobile-optimized.
Use Shadcn UI components for all forms (Admission, Contact, Login).
Do NOT use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use realistic text related to education and the school's mission.
For the 'Results' page, use a clean table layout with clear pass/fail indicators.
Integrate Paystack mock UI for the payment section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
